rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs from ACPE-approved or Board-approved providers; other pharmacy-related programs if the Board approves them (application within 90 days of completion)
rules.audit_note: Pharmacists keep their own CE records; audited licensees submit proof.
rules.notes: License renews annually, but CE is reported every two years by Sept 30 of even-numbered years. Board may grant up to a one-year extension. No Minnesota-specific CE topics.
